label_contract: eval/run.py _build_judge_messages reference-relative matching; entity aliases, property compatibility, relation direction/endpoints
adjudication: Inherited exact indexed pairs from judge/v1 agent review and deterministic contract rules; no independent human labels, no historical judge predictions used as labels
window_policy: Original normalized evidence-stripped graph order, floor(index/40)*40 golden and floor(index/20)*20 predicted; natural tail windows retain actual length; no synthetic or cross-document candidates
truth_scope: Partial reviewed labels only; unknown candidate edges are not negative labels; do not calculate full-window F1
source_integrity: Both original prediction and golden bytes matched registry SHA256 before normalize_graph; recovered alternative paths only with identical hash; anchor objects exact-equal reviewed pair objects including relation endpoint context; additional already-reviewed pairs may be inherited by exact equality of both items within same document window

label_coverage_audit.policy: Every reviewed pair origin is checked against existing window source_id, global bounds and exact source objects; no windows added; duplicate candidate edges excluded.

byte_revision.reason: Canonical Git LF bytes must match the manifest on Windows and Linux.
